181:15.en: 「In my way? I won't hold back.」

181:73.en: 「Not bad... but your finish was weak.」

alternatives: Is this as far as I go?

181:985.en: 「$$デュオ$$, I'll attack from here too.」

181:1018.en: 「$$カトル$$, leave the rest to me.」

181:1583.en: 「I'll hold on to hope till the end.」

181:1612.en: 「Direct hit. I can't take much more.」

181:1643.en: 「Kill me if you wish.\nI may resist.」

181:1733.en: 「They're just like we were. $$デキム$$'s smooth talk has them dancing over why they exist.」

181:2296.en: 「I've been seen. I can't let you go.」

181:2327.en: 「Sorry, destroying is my mission. I'm going.」

181:2366.en: 「As long as there's resolve, I fight.」

181:2397.en: 「I'm going to act on my emotions.」

181:2687.en: 「At this range, this is the one.」

181:2788.en: 「You're an enemy. I won't hold back.」

181:2819.en: 「I'll thin them out, even a little.」

181:2933.en: 「If you mean it, I won't stop you, but...」

181:2976.en: 「I'll hold the damage to a minimum.」

181:3005.en: 「Stop the unit and they can be saved.」

181:3042.en: 「A unit is only as good as its pilot.」

181:3081.en: 「Let me see the new Gundam's power.」

181:3159.en: 「Keep waging war, and I'll face you.」

181:3200.en: 「What you're doing is a repeat\nof a sad history.」

181:3307.en: 「How sad, a woman who can't cry.」

181:3344.en: 「I won't hand the world to someone trapped in the past.」

181:3383.en: 「Looks like I can't lower my guard.」

181:3529.en: 「If we hold the line,\n$$刹那$$ will do the rest.」

181:3578.en: 「How pitiful, a life lived\nonly for fighting...」

181:3938.en: 「So it's unlike any opponent so far.」

181:4055.en: 「You turned enemy. I show no mercy.」

181:4131.en: 「Do you have the power\nto look down on humanity?」

181:4180.en: 「The name of God's apostle ill suits\nsomeone steeped in greed.」

181:4268.en: 「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... I'll end this.」

181:4330.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$. You're a pitiful clown.」

181:4367.en: 「The world and I will\ndefy our fate of death.」

181:4563.en: 「You hit me, so I hit back.」

181:4971.en: 「$$ヒイロ$$, take care of your body.」

181:5149.en: 「A mistake like this is rare, $$ノイン$$.」

181:5182.en: 「Then I'll leave the front to you.」

181:5205.en: 「Pick them off one by one, then.」

181:5249.en: 「So each of us plays our own part.」

181:5535.en: 「I see. So that's all you've got.」

181:5641.en: 「Your read and aim are both sloppy.」

181:5830.en: 「Your emotions are getting ahead of you.」

181:6114.en: 「Beat the enemy before my unit blows.」

181:6209.en: 「If I die, $$キャスリン$$ will cry.\nThat's not what I want.」

181:6297.en: 「Sorry. This is as far as I go.」

181:6326.en: 「Moderation, or you'll end up like these two.」
